posts.name: TheBazaarClerk
posts.cooked:
I loved this episode. I'm a big fan of monsters and occult detectives, so an entire episode just about Nightmist supernatural hijinks was quite pleasant. If I lived in the Sentinels Meta-verse I'm sure Tome of The Bizarre would be my favorite book of the bunch. 

When they mentioned Nightmist fighting a very dangerous creature "starting with G", my first thought was "did she fight GOD?" 

By the way, did they mention what it was? I got a bit distracted at some parts and couldn't get all the details. 

During the magic-eater story I couldn't stop imagining an alternative ending, where Nightmist simply makes a portal to the Realm of Discord and drops the thing on Gloomweavers doorstep. It probably wouldn't work, but it sure made me laugh.

Congratulations to the listener who mentioned the nuckelavee and the penanggalan, you have good taste in monsters (I don't know enough about the mokumokuren to judge it). 

A bit unfortunate that these cool creatures didn't get to appear in the comics, but at least we
